passages.text: OF OPERATIONS. The following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations should be read in conjunction with our consolidated financial statements and related notes that appear elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. In addition to historical information, the following discussion contains forward-looking statements that are subject to risks and uncertainties. Actual results may differ substantially and adversely from those referred to herein due to a number of factors, including, but not limited to, those described below and in Item 1A “Risk Factors” and elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. OVERVIEW We, together with our consolidated subsidiaries, are a U.S.-based global leader in high-performance radio frequency (“RF”), power management, and analog and mixed-signal semiconductor products and solutions, serving mobile and a broad range of diversified markets, including physical AI and connected edge, defense and aerospace, data center and networking, and automotive. Completed Combination With Qorvo On October 5, 2026, we completed the acquisition of Qorvo, Inc. (“Qorvo”), pursuant to two merger transactions involving cash-and-stock consideration (the “Mergers”). Pursuant to the Agreement and Plan of Merger dated October 27, 2025 (the “Merger Agreement”), Qorvo became a wholly owned subsidiary of Skyworks. Under the terms of the Merger Agreement, at the effective time of the transaction, each share of Qorvo common stock issued and outstanding immediately prior to the effective time, subject to certain exceptions set forth in the Merger Agreement, was converted into the right to receive 0.960 of a share of Skyworks common stock and $ 32.50 per share in cash, without interest and subject to applicable withholding taxes. Qorvo stockholders received approximately $ 2.9 billion in cash and 85.3 million shares of Skyworks common stock in the aggregate. We funded the cash portion of the Mergers with the net proceeds from the issuance of an aggregate of $2,000.0 million in senior notes, comprised of $ 800.0 million of 5.00 % Senior Notes due 2028 (the “2028 Notes”), $ 600.0 million of 5.75 % Senior Notes due 2032 (the “2032 Notes”), and $ 600.0 million of 6.25 % Senior Notes due 2036 (the “2036 Notes”), that we issued on August 10, 2026, as well as cash on hand and funds from our revolver. In connection with the completion of the Mergers, we also completed the previously announced exchange offers for $1,550.0 million of outstanding senior notes of Qorvo. Pursuant to the exchange offers, participating holders exchanged their Qorvo senior notes for newly issued senior notes of Skyworks having substantially similar terms. Refer to Note 17 to Item 8 of this Annual Report on Form 10-K for additional information related to the Mergers and exchanged notes. For more information on risks related to the completed Mergers, see Part I, Item 1A, Risk Factors, “Risks Related to Strategic Transactions and Indebtedness” of this Annual Report on Form 10-K. credit_strengths.text: The balance sheet carries a net cash position, with unrestricted cash exceeding interest-bearing debt, and net leverage sits below the sector median on a comparable net-debt basis. Liquidity is ample, with the current ratio far above the sector median and well above one, giving the issuer substantial short-term funding flexibility.

EBITDA coverage of interest expense exceeds the sector median, and operating income covers gross interest several times over despite the sharp year-on-year decline in coverage. This reflects the still-modest absolute coupon burden relative to the enlarged debt stack after the refinancing.

key_risks.text: Gross leverage rose sharply year on year and now sits well above the sector median, driven by the new senior notes issued to fund the Qorvo cash consideration. The debt note shows the stack extended into longer maturities, so refinancing risk is deferred but the absolute debt burden has more than doubled.

Operating margin compressed sharply year on year and is far below the sector median, with revenue declining across the trend. Weaker operating profitability, combined with integration risk from the completed combination, is the central threat to cash generation and therefore to debt service capacity.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Operating cash flow covers dividends and buybacks combined, but free cash flow falls short of total shareholder distributions, meaning distributions absorb more than the internally generated cash after capex. Funding therefore leans on the cash balance and revolver rather than recurring free cash flow.

Free cash flow to debt and operating cash flow to debt both declined sharply year on year and sit well below sector medians, indicating weaker cash-flow-based debt protection than peers. Coverage remains adequate but the trend direction is adverse and warrants monitoring through the integration period.

overall_credit_view.text: The indicative financial risk profile is minimal on a net cash basis, supported by strong liquidity and a long-dated maturity profile following the refinancing. However, gross leverage above the sector median and compressed margins mean the cushion depends on restoring operating profitability rather than on the balance sheet alone.

Our forward view is that credit quality hinges on integrating the acquired business and rebuilding operating margin toward sector levels; absent that, free cash flow will continue to underfund distributions and erode the net cash position. We view the profile as stable but with limited headroom for further debt-funded actions.

credit_strengths.text: 資產負債表持有淨現金狀況，未受限現金超過計息債務，且按可比的淨債務基準計算，淨槓桿低於行業中位數。流動性充裕，流動比率遠高於行業中位數且遠高於一，賦予發行人充裕的短期資金靈活性。
EBITDA對利息費用的覆蓋率超過行業中位數，儘管覆蓋率按年大幅下降，營業收入仍數倍覆蓋總利息。這反映在再融資後債務規模擴大之下，絕對票息負擔仍然溫和。

key_risks.text: 總槓桿按年大幅上升，現時遠高於行業中位數，主因是為支付Qorvo現金對價而發行的新優先票據。債務附註顯示債務結構已延伸至較長到期日，故再融資風險被推遲，但絕對債務負擔已增加逾一倍。
營業利潤率按年大幅收窄，且遠低於行業中位數，收入在整個趨勢中持續下降。盈利能力轉弱，加上已完成合併所帶來的整合風險，是現金產生能力、因而亦是償債能力的核心威脅。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 經營現金流可覆蓋股息與回購的合計金額，但自由現金流不足以覆蓋股東分派總額，意味著分派所吸收的金額超過資本開支後的內部產生現金。因此資金來源依賴現金餘額及循環信貸，而非經常性自由現金流。
自由現金流對債務比率及經營現金流對債務比率均按年大幅下降，且遠低於行業中位數，顯示以現金流為基礎的債務保障弱於同業。覆蓋率仍然充足，但趨勢方向不利，值得在整合期內持續監察。

overall_credit_view.text: 按淨現金基準，指示性財務風險狀況為極低，並有強勁流動性及再融資後較長到期結構的支持。然而，總槓桿高於行業中位數及利潤率受壓，意味著緩衝取決於恢復營業盈利能力，而非僅依賴資產負債表。
我們的前瞻觀點是，信貸質素取決於整合所收購業務並將營業利潤率重建至行業水平；若未能做到，自由現金流將繼續不足以支持分派，並侵蝕淨現金狀況。我們認為該狀況為穩定，但進一步以債務融資行動的空間有限。
